explanation: The revealed solution confirms f'(x)=3(x+1)^2, which is positive on both sides of its only zero, x=-1. Since the derivative does not change sign, there is no local maximum or minimum. Thus the function has no local extrema.

answers.correct_value: The function $f(x)$ has no local extrema
